title: Terminal panes: pop-out, keys and focus, menus, : commands, transcript rows (no app.js edits)
what:
terms/pane.js, the 'term' pane kind:
- title `⌨ <title> ▾ [proj] ●`
- menu: copy, paste, select all, clear, split right ▸, split down ▸, back to the stack, end terminal… (confirmed)
- glyphs: + (split), × (back to the stack, toast 'terminal back in ⌨'; the process keeps running)
- host: a padded outer div with an unpadded inner div (position:relative; z-index:0), so fit measures right and xterm stays under the frame
- resize: ResizeObserver debounced 120 ms -> fit.proposeDimensions -> optimistic resize + POST resize; the perch's term-size is final
- ⇱ opens a pane along the long side; the stack keeps the placeholder; closing the pane moves the same element back
terms/keys.js:
- keyOwner and focusOwner for .tview
- attachCustomKeyEventHandler: ctrl+c copies with a selection, else goes to the PTY; ctrl+shift+c copies; ctrl+v and ctrl+shift+v use the native paste (bracketed when enabled)
- right-click opens our menu, unless the app has mouse tracking (then shift+right-click)
- beforeunload guard armed only while focus is in a terminal (D11)
- i or ⏎ on a focused frame focuses the terminal
Registrations through S0W-b's registries; app.js is not edited:
- whereOwners: 'term' for .tview
- commands, per D11 item 3:
  - override `term` to open a web terminal at the focused chat's cwd
  - add `window` (`:window term|edit|files`), which calls the old native launcher p.s.launch (app.js:525)
- keyRows: ':term :edit :files' becomes ':term (web terminal) · :window term|edit|files (native)'
- splitExtras: 'terminal ▸ [ new terminal (here: <cwd>) | in folder… | each terminal not in a pane ]'
- the status line for a term pane: title · cols×rows · cwd · agent
renderers/term.js draws term_* transcript rows (input summary, read text folded, 'open in ⌨'), plus one line in renderers/index.js.
tests:
termkeys.test.mjs:
- keyOwner claims only .tview descendants
- the copy/paste decision table
- a term pane's split items drop mirror and anchor on the pane id
- the `term` override and the `window` command resolve as registered
live_check:
fake perch on PORT=48133:
- ⇱ then × move the same element (identity check in the console)
- ctrl+b, ctrl+i and alt+w reach the shell while the rails stay put
- an ask arriving while a terminal has focus does not take it, and the status shows ▶ waiting
- dragging a divider resizes the PTY (the text route shows the new width)
- `:term` opens a web terminal; `:window term` calls the native launcher (fake door logs it)
- console clean
risk:
- Browser-reserved chords (ctrl+w/t/n) cannot be captured; only the guard asks.
- ResizeObserver does not fire in a background tab (app.js:1449).
